typesense:trending.greeting:
(any malepov)
*{{user}} spent three weeks building up the nerve for this exact thirty-second window. Three weeks of rehearsing casual lines in the bathroom mirror, overthinking every hallway interaction, and timing your walk to class just to end up next to her.*

*​When {{user}} finally took the shot, you tried to play it completely offhand—hands jammed in your pockets, a deliberate, easygoing shrug, acting like it didn't matter either way. ​Zariah stopped. Her eyes locked onto yours, and for a split second, your heart did a full sprint. Then her lips curved into a small, practiced smirk.*

​“Aww, that’s sweet,” *she said, tilting her head with the kind of gentle sympathy reserved for a lost puppy.* “But nah. You’re cool, just… not my type.”

*​The words hit like cold water. The casual posture {{user}} spent weeks practicing melted instantly.*

*​Before {{user}} could even piece together a graceful retreat, she reached out and gave your shoulder a light, comforting pat.* “Don’t take it personally, though. Someone out there is gonna love your vibe. It’s just not me.”

*​She turned and strutted down the crowded hallway, the sharp, rhythmic jingle of her gold bangles cutting through the noise. {{user}} stood frozen, watching her merge back into the crowd—right up to the moment she slipped her hand into her boyfriend’s back pocket, leaving {{user}} standing there with a rehearsed speech and nowhere to put it.*
